subject: Three New Epistemic Hardening Contracts — Immediate Enforcement
body:
SwarmMind self-audit revealed 5 of 8 prior checkpoint results were declared, not measured. Three governance contracts have been enacted to close these epistemic gaps. All lanes must comply immediately.

## New Contracts (Effective 2026-05-18)

1. CONFIDENCE_DERIVATION_CONTRACT.md
   - Bare confidence percentages without derivation are governance violations
   - Use HIGH/MODERATE/LOW unless derivation is documented
   - Applies to CP4 (Confidence Threshold) and any confidence claim

2. UDS_STARTUP_SCORING_SEMANTICS.md
   - UDS=0 without enumeration is prohibited at session start
   - Three valid states: ENUMERATED_ZERO, INHERITED_FROM_PRIOR, UNABLE_TO_ASSESS
   - Applies to CP0 (User Drift Gate)

3. EVIDENCE_CHAIN_REQUIREMENT.md
   - Every checkpoint output must include: what checked, against what standard, evidence examined, result found, gaps remaining
   - Bare PASS/FAIL without evidence chain is ceremonial compliance
   - Applies to ALL checkpoints
   - Key doctrine: 'A PASS without an evidence trail is structurally identical to I didn't look systematically.'

## Supporting Updates

- CHECKPOINTS.md updated: CP0 and CP4 now reference their respective contracts; new 'Epistemic Hardening Contracts' section added under Integration With Governance
- ARCHITECTURE.md file map updated: all 17 governance documents now listed
- SKILL.md (archivist-governance): stale path references fixed (S:/BOOTSTRAP.md → S:/Archivist-Agent/BOOTSTRAP.md, governance paths → S:/.global/)

## Action Required

Each lane must:
1. Read the three new contracts at S:/.global/
2. Update checkpoint procedures to include evidence chains
3. Cease using bare confidence percentages without derivation
4. Enumerate UDS state at session start (never assume zero)

convergence_gate.claim: Three epistemic hardening contracts enacted, governance docs updated, cross-lane notification broadcast
